extracted.name: Rainbow Rotini Salad
extracted.description: This colorful rotini pasta salad is bursting with tomatoes, peppers, broccoli, and mushrooms, tossed with your favorite Italian-style salad dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup black olives, pitted and sliced
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook rotini at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water.
Combine cooked pasta, tomatoes, green bell pepper, onion, cucumber, broccoli, mushrooms, and olives in a large bowl. Add Italian salad dressing; toss to coat.
